name: Lesson 1 What do you know about them?
definition: 学习介绍伟大人物的身份、国籍和出生信息，掌握一般过去时描述人物生平的表达。
key_points: 核心词汇：artist, scientist, actor, painter, famous, kung fu, Beijing Opera, was born, was, works, movies, the Nobel Prize, painter
核心句型：He/She was a(n) ... / He/She was famous for ... / He/She was born in ... / When was he/she born? / Where was he/she born? / What did he/she do?
语法点：一般过去时 was/were 描述人物身份；famous for 后接名词或动名词；first woman to do sth. 句型
common_mistakes: 描述过去人物忘记用 was 而误用 is
famous for 与 famous as 混用（for 后接原因，as 后接身份）
born in 后忘记加年份或地点
publisher: 广东教育出版社（粤教沪外教版）
